title: dispatch project registry
description: One entry per project: which dandisets it maps incoming -> standardized, and how to run its conversion script. A lab running several projects names each one with 'project'. See ../README.md for the full field reference.

lab.description: Must match the labs/<lab>/ directory. Alone, it is also the project's sessions.json key and --only value; with 'project' set, that key becomes '<lab>/<project>'.

project.description: Optional project name, for a lab contributing more than one data collection (e.g. 'in-lab'). Must match the labs/<lab>/<project>/ directory. When set, the project is keyed '<lab>/<project>' in sessions.json and --only. Omit for a lab with a single project.

incoming_dandiset_id.description: Dandiset id on the ember archive holding the raw upload.

standardized_dandiset_id.description: Dandiset id the converted/standardized output is uploaded to. May equal incoming_dandiset_id.

script_path.description: Path (repo-root-relative) to the conversion script, hashed to detect when it changes.

convert_command.description: Argv list to run the conversion. Tokens may use {repo_root}, {incoming_dir}, {standardized_dir}, plus any key from metadata (e.g. {species}) -- rarely needed, since every metadata entry is also auto-appended as its own --<key> <value> flag; only use a placeholder when a value needs to land somewhere other than a trailing flag.

dandi_instance.description: DANDI archive instance name (per `dandi instance-list`), e.g. ember-dandi / ember-dandi-sandbox.

overwrite_flag.description: Optional single flag appended to convert_command when script_path's hash has changed.

container_image.description: Optional image (e.g. ghcr.io/brain-bbqs/<lab>-ingest:latest) to run convert_command inside via 'docker run', instead of directly on the runner host. Holds only the lab's runtime environment -- code and data are bind-mounted in at run time, not baked into the image.

metadata.description: Project-wide values (e.g. {"species": "Ovis aries"}). Each entry is automatically appended to convert_command as its own --<key> <value> flag (underscores in the key become dashes), so a lab doesn't need to name it in its own command template. Keys may not reuse the reserved repo_root/incoming_dir/standardized_dir placeholder names.
